Initial release of the work-productivity-skillscan-security-workflow-helper skill.

- Provides practical workflows and artifacts for SkillScan-style demand in agent productivity and security.
- Focuses on bug fixes, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and adjacent skill creation.
- Uses evidence-based demand validation, with broad support across multiple sources.
- Produces local-friendly outputs: scripts, templates, checklists, and small-model workflows.
- Includes a validation process and reusable components for repeatable tasks.
